scope: Clan war governance, weekly readiness and original cooperative-operations UI

userDecisions.ready: 15 minutes before start; responses never gate eligibility
userDecisions.authority: Top three latest ranked-deck power members are executives; appointed commander uses skills
userDecisions.scoring: Existing win +3 / loss +1 attacker-only scoring retained; no attendance percentage bonus or equal win/loss score
userDecisions.operations: Approved 15-point ceiling per member per war: three missions at 3 points (9), distinct three-member combo once (3), first actual spending of personally supplied command once (3). Tactical skills never add uncapped points; refunds have no member owner.
userDecisions.command: Skills use 60 command minus 5 per intel (max 3); cooldown 120 seconds; FIFO supply provenance; departed-member supply never credits a new clan.

verification.migration: Production dry run rolled back; 16 future matches only; completed matches unchanged

finalBalance.scope: Real PostgreSQL rollback/replay, supply ownership, all 8 clan skills, 9+3+3 ceiling, no score from returned resources, departure, time limits

assets.visualReview: Verified artwork, text, button bounds, clan crests and mobile layout

balanceExamples.assumption: 36 attacks per active member; every member earns all 15 operation points; stronger player 24 wins/12 losses, weaker player 14 wins/22 losses
